get.description:
Return recent tracing spans and reliability snapshot.

limit: max number of spans to return (recent tail).

post.description:
Manually trigger span export flush when TRACE_OTLP_EXPORT enabled.

Returns number of flushed spans written this invocation.

get.description:
Return most recent IOC hit records (reverse chronological).

Query params:
    - limit: max records (1..200)
    - ioc_type: filter by IOC type
    - value: substring match on IOC value
    - tenant: tenant id filter
    - since_ts: only include hits with ts >= since_ts

Return basic statistics about hunting buffers & IOC hits.

Fields:
  hunt_event_buffer_size: current size of hunt buffer
  hunt_last_event_ts: timestamp of most recent event (or null)
  hunt_distinct_tenants: number of distinct tenant_ids in buffer
  ioc_hits_size: current number of retained IOC hit records
  ioc_hits_last_ts: most recent IOC hit ts (or null)
  ioc_hits_distinct_values: count of distinct IOC values in ring

Return SNN enablement and last observed key metric values (best-effort).

Metrics sampled:
  snn_activity, snn_residual_activity, snn_predicted_activity, snn_spike_density

post.description:
Enable or disable SNN via runtime param detection.enable_snn.

Body: {"enabled": true|false}

get.description: Return fusion overlap/unique ratios & suppression stats (best-effort snapshot).
Return current fusion weights (runtime params fusion.weight.*).

post.description:
Update one or more fusion weights.

Body: {"weights": {"detector_name": float, ...}}

get.description:
Server-Sent Events stream of fusion decision tail.

Implementation: simple polling loop watching underlying list length.
Best-effort; not intended for high-scale multi-subscriber production yet.

Return recent governance shadow recommendations (non-mutating advisory) with pagination.

Query Params:
  limit: max records to return (1..200)
  offset: zero-based offset into filtered chronological list (newest first)
  tenant: optional tenant id filter
  action: optional action filter (raise_threshold|lower_threshold)

Response Shape:
  {
    "items": [...],
    "limit": int,
    "offset": int,
    "returned": int,
    "total": int,
    "more": bool,
    "tenant_filter": str|None,
    "action_filter": str|None,
    "ts": epoch_seconds
  }

post.description:
Trigger on-demand generation provider warmup.

Returns status JSON even if generation disabled (so orchestrators can call idempotently).

get.description:
Unified configuration & policy introspection endpoint (paginated).

Query Params:
  limit: page size for runtime params slice (1..1000, default 100)
  offset: zero-based offset into sorted runtime param key list
  full: if true, include the full runtime map (may be large) in addition to paginated slice

Auth (optional):
  If runtime param `diagnostics.auth.required` is truthy, caller must supply header `x-diagnostics-key`
  matching runtime param `diagnostics.auth.key` (constant-time compare best-effort). On failure -> 401.

Response Shape:
  {
    "runtime": { "items": [{"key": str, "value": any}, ...], "limit": int, "offset": int, "returned": int, "total": int, "more": bool },
    "policies": [...],
    "exceptions": [...],
    "bounds": {...},
    "ts": epoch_seconds,
    (optional) "runtime_full": {k: v, ...} when full=true
  }

Return recent findings with emergence probability & related factors.

Parameters:
  limit: max findings to return (recent by last_seen)
  refresh: if true, trigger a best-effort risk recompute before listing

Return feature importances for emergence probability model (heuristic fallback).

If a trained model exposing .feature_importances_ (sklearn-style) or a dict `EMERGENCE_IMPORTANCE`
is available, surface that; otherwise provide static heuristic weights for transparency.

List open findings whose SLA due date falls within the next N days.

Parameters:
  days: window forward to consider
  limit: max rows returned

post.description:
Aggregate open findings into remediation ticket batches grouped by component and severity.

Body fields (optional):
  severities: list[str] severity filters (default all)
  max_findings_per_ticket: int soft cap to split large groups

Upload SBOM for ingestion (sync or async based on toggle / query param).

Query Params / Form Fields:
  asset_id: stable asset identifier (required)
  asset_name: optional human name
  sync: force synchronous processing even if async is enabled (default False)
  file: SBOM JSON (CycloneDX or SPDX)

get.description:
Return ingest event counters and freshness status per connector.

Status rules:
  - OK if at least one event in last 3600s
  - STALE otherwise
Always returns 200 for observability; no dependency on feed state storage to keep tests simple.

Aggregate ingest source health using emitted metrics and event counters.

Classifies each source:
  OK: event in last hour
  STALE: no event in last hour but < 24h
  ERROR: lag metric > configured threshold (ingest.health.error_lag_s) or never active

post.description:
Conversational retrieval+generation endpoint.

Body fields:
  query: user question (string, required)
  k: optional top-k per subquery (1-20, default 5)
Returns answer, citations, slim contexts, timings, trace id.

get.description:
Return recent adaptive governance actions & current suppression threshold.

If tenant provided, filter to that tenant; else return per-tenant mapping.

Return combined dashboard snapshot.

Multi-tenant note: current aggregator is global; tenant filtering placeholder returns full snapshot with requested tenant label.
Future: filter per-tenant metrics & exposure slices.

post.description:
On-demand unified report generation.

Triggers `reports.unified_pipeline.build_report_bundle` irrespective of scheduler state and
returns artifact paths. Protected by admin API key (same scope as param updates).
Generate HTML + PDF bundle explicitly (wrapper convenience).

Execute a single planning/executive cycle across registered agents.

Returns list of agent result dicts plus current shared context snapshot.
Safe idempotent diagnostic endpoint (no side effects beyond agent logic).

Execute end-to-end retrieval pipeline (plan -> retrieve -> corrective refinement).

Body fields:
  query (str, required): user query
  k (int, optional, default 5): per-subquery top-k context retrieval depth

Gated by runtime param `retrieval.pipeline.enabled`; returns 503 if disabled. Provides
timings + corrective refinement trace. Best-effort: if orchestrator unavailable returns 501.

Search retrieval chunks using simple include/exclude keyword filters and time bounds.

Body fields:
  include (list[str]) - keywords that must appear (ANY match if multiple; scored union).
  exclude (list[str]) - keywords that must NOT appear.
  since_ts (float) / until_ts (float) - optional epoch bounds against synthetic `discovered_at` field
    (placeholder: currently not stored; filter ignored until persistence wired).
  k (int) - max results (default 10, capped 100).

Returns list of chunk records (doc, chunk_id, score, explanation subset). This is a thin wrapper
over `retrieve_context` using the include keywords as separate queries and merging results.

get.description:
Return vulnerability findings with pagination & sorting.

Query Params:
  severity: optional filter risk severity (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW)
  asset_id: optional filter by asset
  page (>=1), page_size (1..500)
  sort: one of risk_score|last_seen|severity (default last_seen)
  include_factors: include lightweight risk factor expansion (future placeholder)

List recent daily assessment summaries or return specific day.

Query params:
  day: if provided (YYYYMMDD) returns that day's JSON record directly.
  limit: max number of recent days (default 30).

post.description:
Trigger a single on-demand vulnerability scan cycle (normalization + risk + catalog matching).

Returns summary including latency, new findings counts, and open findings after scan.

get.description: Minimal HTML findings list with basic filters (MVP).

Correlate recent anomalies with vulnerability findings by asset_id.

If asset_id is provided, returns findings and anomalies for that asset.
If not, returns top N assets with both anomalies and findings.

post.description:
Trigger vulnerability snapshot generation (manifest + signature chain) and return metadata.

Executes the existing script `scripts/generate_vuln_snapshot.py` in a subprocess so it can
reuse its internal async DB load logic without code duplication. Captures its JSON output.
